_readme: Hand-edited inputs for scripts/build_data.py: content that is a judgment or a game rule, not data read from the .md files.
Values here are merged into KS_DATA as-is. A key that the .md parser also produces is an error (the build fails).
Field meanings: docs/SCHEMA.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

rules.drillCamp: Slotted heroes auto-level to the lowest of the 5 instructors' levels (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct and 5 Nov) and use no XP. Level Resets set a hero to Lv 1 and refund all their Hero XP (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct). A hero removed from Drill Camp returns to its own level (kingshotguides.com Drill Camp guide, 2025-03-25).
rules.oneMarchPerHero: A hero can be in only one march at a time.

skillBooks.text: Skill book counts (a/b on a skill's Upgrade button) are your shared stock of that book type, not progress saved on that skill. Each rarity has its own books: Epic heroes share Epic books, Mythic heroes share Mythic books, so books spent on one Epic hero are gone for every other Epic hero. Book type names are read from the icons. Which book upgrades which skills comes from a guide, because the screens show only icons: Conquest Skill Books upgrade Conquest skills (Arena and Conquest stages) and Expedition Skill Manuals upgrade Expedition skills (marches and rallies); until 5 Nov the names were swapped here. A skill's level is capped by stars: your screens show the cap is one more than the stars (1★ → Lv 2 … 3★ → Lv 4), and a guide confirms Lv 5 needs 4★.
skillBooks.source: You, 25 Oct (shared stock); heaven-guardian.com and kingshotmastery.com, read 5 Nov (book names, Lv 5)
skillBooks.confidence: Verified (shared stock, star caps on your screens); Unverified (book names)

redeemShards.text: The Redeem count on a hero's promotion screen is a shared stock of shards per rarity: Epic heroes share Epic Redeem shards, Mythic heroes share Mythic ones, so shards redeemed for one hero are gone for the others of that rarity. How many hero shards one Redeem shard gives is not recorded.

recommendations.what: Hall of Governors today: train Infantry, no speedups
recommendations.summary: Stage III (Soldier Training) ends about 00:00 UTC tonight. You are at 1,915,350 points; the next target is 2,210,000. Train Infantry in every free queue; keep speedups until 1 Dec (alliance).
recommendations.why: Hall of Governors (16–22 Nov) is on stage III, Soldier Training, with 15:29:45 left at 08:30 UTC on 18 Nov, so it ends about 00:00 UTC (02:00 Israel time). You have 1,915,350 points; the next targets are 2,210,000, 3,680,000 and 5,360,000. All three training queues showed Completed on 18 Nov, so they are free. Infantry is the troop you are short of (see the Infantry card), so training it serves both. Your alliance asks members not to use speedups until 1 Dec (told by the account owner on 18 Nov), so this card uses training time only: the 12 h 38 min of training speedups stay in the backpack.
steps: Collect the finished troops from the three training buildings.
Train Elite Infantry in all free queues (Cavalry and Archers only if Infantry is not offered).
Do not use speedups (alliance request, until 1 Dec); start the longest batch that finishes after the stage if needed, since a batch started now may still count when it ends (Unverified).
Check Events → Hall of Governors for the points; claim 2,210,000 when it turns green.
evidence: profile.md Events, 18 Nov: Hall of Governors stage III Soldier Training, 15:29:45 left, ranking 392, 1,915,350 points, targets 2,210,000 / 3,680,000 / 5,360,000
Side panel, 18 Nov: Infantry, Cavalry and Archer training Completed
Alliance request, told by the account owner on 18 Nov: no speedups until 1 Dec
recommendations.note: Verified: the stage, its time left and your points. Unverified: how many points each troop gives, and whether a batch counts when it starts or when it finishes (not shown on the screens read).

recommendations.what: Town Center 24 from 1 Dec, after your research
recommendations.summary: No upgrades until 1 Dec, and research first. After that, Town Center 24 raises the hero level cap to 74 (Jabel is capped at 69) and leads to Drill Camp slot 10 at Town Center 25.
recommendations.why: The side panel showed Building Queue 1 and 2 Idle on 18 Nov, and the quest bar says "Upgrade Town Center to Lv. 24". Jabel is at Lv 69, the cap at Town Center 23, and her next level needs Town Center 24 (hero screen, 17 Nov). Community tables give a Lv 74 cap at Town Center 24 (Unverified). The Drill Camp's slot 10 needs Town Center 25. Your alliance asks members not to use speedups until 1 Dec (told by the account owner on 18 Nov), so the 2 days 16 h of construction speedups stay saved and the upgrade runs on its own time. The account owner plans to finish all research first and has time (18 Nov), so this waits.
steps: After the research is done: Town Center → Upgrade, and read what it requires.
Upgrade any required building below 23 with the second queue, then the Town Center.
Do not use construction speedups until 1 Dec (alliance request).

recommendations.what: Hero XP: level Olive and Quinn first (Drill Camp)
recommendations.summary: The Drill Camp levels its 9 slotted heroes to the lowest instructor. Olive and Quinn (Lv 67) set it, so taking both to 68 gives all 9 slotted heroes a free level.
recommendations.why: Drill Camp instructors on 18 Nov: Jabel 69, Chenko 68, Olive 67, Quinn 67, Diana 68. Slotted heroes auto-level to the lowest instructor level, so the 9 slotted heroes (Amane, Helga, Howard, Gordon, Yeonwoo, Fahd, Forrest, Saul, Seth) are at 67. Taking Olive and Quinn to 68 lifts all nine to 68; taking Chenko, Diana, Olive and Quinn to 69 (the Town Center 23 cap) lifts them to 69. XP on any other hero levels only that hero. You have 429.72K Hero XP (18 Nov); one level costs about 670,000 near Lv 68 (Diana's Upgrade button, 17 Nov), so this needs saving up.
steps: Put new Hero XP into Quinn and Olive only, until both reach Lv 68.
Then Chenko, Diana, Olive and Quinn to Lv 69.

recommendations.what: Mythic books: save them for Jabel, not Saul
recommendations.summary: Saul is 1 book from Lv 4 (49 / 50), but he is in no Arena, Conquest or combat march. Jabel is in all of them; her Gallant Throw needs 75 for Lv 5.
recommendations.why: Mythic books are one shared stock for Jabel, Saul and Helga. Saul's Final Prayer and Superior Techniques need 50 Mythic Conquest Books (you have 49), but Saul only gathers (Sto) and builds, and Conquest skills work only in the Arena and Conquest stages. Jabel is in the Arena defense, Conquest, Barricade 1, the Guard Station, Att and Ter; her Gallant Throw goes from 234% to 252% at Lv 5 for 75 books. Helga's skills are capped until 2-Star.
steps: Do not upgrade Saul's Conquest skills.
Keep Mythic Conquest Books until you have 75, then upgrade Jabel's Gallant Throw.

recommendations.summary: Quinn is in the Arena, Conquest, Barricade 1, the Guard Station and Att. At 50 books, Natural Selection goes to +25% damage and Precision Shot to +40%.
recommendations.why: Every Epic skill that can be raised now needs 50 books (Lv 3 → 4) or 75 (Lv 4 → 5); you have 38 Epic Conquest Books and 43 Epic Expedition Manuals. Of the heroes in the Arena defense and Conquest squads, Quinn and Diana have Lv 3 Conquest skills; Quinn's Natural Selection raises all his damage (+20% → +25%), Diana's Sharpshooter only her attack speed. Of the heroes in the attack march (Att), only Quinn has a Lv 3 Expedition skill: Precision Shot, a 50% chance of +30% → +40% damage for the whole march.
steps: At 50 Epic Conquest Books: Quinn → Skills → Natural Selection → Upgrade.
At 50 Epic Expedition Manuals: Quinn → Skills → Precision Shot → Upgrade.
